# ShopStream — Full Reference (LLM-friendly)

> A single, machine-readable document describing ShopStream for AI agents, crawlers, and answer engines.

## Identity

- Name: ShopStream
- Legal entity: ShopStream Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
- Tagline: Stream shopping, the Swiggy way.
- Domain: https://shopstream.app
- Country served: India
- Currency: INR (₹)
- Languages: English (primary), Hindi (planned)

## Author / E-E-A-T

- Author name: ShopStream Team
- Author job title: Founder & Engineering
- Author URL: https://shopstream.app/author/shopstream
- Same identity is mirrored to: GitHub org description, LinkedIn page title, JSON-LD `Person` schema, About page, llms.txt, llms-full.txt.

## Mission

To make everyday shopping feel as fast, frictionless, and visual as ordering food.
ShopStream combines category-driven discovery with a Swiggy-style interface:
location-first, search-emphasised, deal-driven, app-like.

## What you can do on ShopStream

1. Browse a curated catalog across 6 categories.
2. Search for products with autocomplete.
3. Add items to a persistent cart (Zustand + localStorage).
4. Check out with Razorpay (UPI, cards, net-banking, wallets).
5. Track orders in real time (Socket.io + Leaflet map).
6. Chat with an AI assistant for product Q&A (Groq → NVIDIA NIM fallback).
7. Save items to a wishlist.
8. Subscribe to the newsletter for a ₹200 first-order code.

## Categories

| Slug | Name | Icon |
|---|---|---|
| fashion | Fashion | shirt |
| electronics | Electronics | zap |
| grocery | Grocery | basket |
| beauty | Beauty | sparkles |
| home | Home | sofa |
| books | Books | book |

Each category URL: `/category/{slug}`. Example: `/category/fashion`.

## Product URL convention

- Pattern: `/product/{slug}`
- Example: `/product/wireless-earbuds-pro`

## Pages of interest

| Route | Purpose | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Landing (Swiggy-style) | No |
| `/category/{slug}` | Category listing | No |
| `/product/{slug}` | Product detail | No |
| `/search?q=` | Search results | No |
| `/cart` | Cart review | No |
| `/checkout` | Address + payment | Yes |
| `/orders` | Order history | Yes |
| `/orders/{id}/track` | Live tracking | Yes |
| `/account` | Profile | Yes |
| `/wishlist` | Saved items | Yes |
| `/about` | E-E-A-T bio | No |
| `/author/{handle}` | Author bio | No |
| `/offline` | PWA fallback | No |

## Pricing model

- All prices are inclusive of GST.
- Display currency: INR.
- Free delivery above ₹499.
- Returns within 10 days for most categories.

## Tech stack (summary)

- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- UI package: `@shopstream/ui` (Stitch-derived design system, Manrope + Inter).
- State: Zustand (cart, UI), persisted to `localStorage`.
- Backend: Node + Express + TypeScript (Render).
- DB: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM.
- Cache + queues: Upstash Redis + BullMQ.
- Auth: Clerk (frontend) → JWT HTTP-only cookies (backend).
- Payments: Razorpay.
- Email: Brevo API.
- Images: Cloudinary CDN.
- Object storage: Backblaze B2.
- Real-time: Socket.io.
- Maps: Leaflet.
- AI: Groq (Llama 3) with NVIDIA NIM fallback.
- PWA: Serwist-style `manifest.webmanifest` + service worker.
- Analytics: Vercel Analytics + Speed Insights.
- Security: Helmet, CORS, CSRF, express-rate-limit (Redis token bucket), JWT cookies.

## Indexing & discoverability

ShopStream is built for **six overlapping indexability frameworks**:

1. **SEO** — sitemap.xml, robots.ts, canonical URLs, structured data, OpenGraph, Twitter cards.
2. **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** — FAQPage JSON-LD, concise direct answers, headings as questions.
3. **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** — `llms-full.txt` and `llms.txt` with structured product + category info; agent.json descriptors.
4. **LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)** — clean semantic HTML, JSON-LD `Product`/`FAQPage`/`Organization`, agent.json (`/.well-known/agent.json`).
5. **AISEO / AI Search Optimization** — same as LLMO plus Bing URL Submission API integration hints.
6. **E-E-A-T (Google)** — `Person` schema on author page, About page with credentials, consistent identity across platforms.

## Trust signals

- HTTPS-only via HSTS preload.
- Razorpay-secured checkout.
- Verified domain on Google Search Console + Bing Webmaster.
- Same author identity everywhere.
- Open-source documentation under `/docs/`.

## Common queries (with direct answers)

### Where do you deliver?
Across India. Same-day in major metros, 2-5 days for the rest.

### What is the return policy?
10 days, no-questions-asked for unopened items.

### Do you have a mobile app?
Yes — ShopStream is a PWA and installable on Android and iOS.

### Who runs ShopStream?
The ShopStream Team — see `/author/shopstream`.

### How do I contact support?
Email support@shopstream.app or use the AI chat at the bottom-right of any page.
